item.title: 2026 Audi Q7 Review | Practical and Quiet Luxury
item.description: The 2026 Audi Q7 comes with a twin turbocharged V6 mated to a mild hybrid system that punches out 340 horsepower, which is enough to propel it from 0-100km/h before you know it, but at the same time, it's also a comfortable cruiser, but also at the same time, it can go off-road thanks to its Quattro all wheel drive system. It seems like the full package but is there a chink in this German's armor? Let us show you its ins and outs on this episode of Behind the Wheel.

item.title: Top 10 Cars of 2025! | Behind a Desk
item.description: It's been a great year, and we want to welcome 2026 with a compiled list of our top 10 best drives. In 2025 we saw tons of electrified passenger vehicles, better performance cars, and value across the board. The industry is better than ever and these 10 cars all encapsulate progress and innovation, as well as an exciting drive. Did your favorite car make it on to this list? What did we miss? What should we review for 2026? Watch the video and sound off in the comments!

item.title: Is the Mitsubishi Pajero making a comeback?
item.description: The Pajero has been out of Mitsubishi’s lineup for a while now, but a recently released teaser video hints at a return.
